card.name: Inside SGLT2 and dabigatran names
card.fires_on: The piece of a drug name just before its ending, mainly the T in SGLT2, the at in dabigatran, and the iga in Farxiga. It appears in diabetes and anticoagulant labels.

modes.label: SGLT2 class name
modes.description: The T inside SGLT2 before the number 2 and the word inhibitors.
modes.example: patients taking SGL<<T>>2 inhibitors. Intervention Monitoring glycemic control

modes.label: Dabigatran name
modes.description: The at piece partway through dabigatran before ran etexilate.
modes.example: Dabig<<at>>ran etexilate capsules use not recommended

modes.label: Farxiga brand name
modes.description: The iga piece inside the brand name Farxiga before its trademark sign.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are odd fragments, so it adds no clear output effect beyond expecting the name to continue.
card.plain: It lights up partway through a few specific drug names, such as SGLT2 inhibitors, dabigatran and Farxiga.
